description.value:
Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Scarlet Needle] and the other Scorpio Techniques.

The badge counts the needles currently in this creature. Scorpio's Techniques read that count: 5 needles is the requirement for @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Antares], and @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Crimson Mirage] deals 1d6 mental damage per needle.

At 15 needles the Scorpio Saint may draw them all at once. Remove this effect when the needles are removed.
